title.zh: Cosmos hub halts for 24 hours after Neutron governance attack
title.en: Cosmos hub halts for 24 hours after Neutron governance attack

current_state.zh: Cosmos Hub validators halted block production for more than 24 hours after a malicious 'AI Agent Takeover' governance proposal passed on Neutron, allowing an attacker to take control of the Astroport and Drop applications and drain contracts, with about 20% of the ~$9.5M in affected assets extracted before block production resumed on Wednesday.
